newsitem.title: USA: Intel, techs to take U.S. stocks higher.
newsitem.headline: Intel, techs to take U.S. stocks higher.

text.p: Strength in shares of Intel Corp will power the high techs and take Wall Street stocks higher at the opening on Thursday in a follow through to Wednesday's rally which ended a week-long losing streak for the Dow Industrials.

Once trading is under way, the tone for Dow will be set by bellwether International Business Machines Corp, and investors will also turn their attention to Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony before the Senate Finance Committee.
The testimony will dictate the performance of the bond market, which in turn, will affect equities.
